sources.fng: Alternative.me Fear & Greed index, daily, 2018-02-01 onward (brain/patterns/fng.csv)
sources.price: Binance BTCUSDT 1-day klines, public data-api.binance.vision, 2018-01-01 onward (spot USDT, no leverage)
sources.entry_rule: No lookahead: if F&G on date D meets the threshold, enter at the next daily close (D+1 close). Outcomes use closes D+1+N. MAE uses lows of the days after entry through day N.

walkforward.selection_rule: On 2018-2022 only, among thresholds {10,15,20,25} with at least 8 hold-30d spot trades, pick the highest excess mean vs all-day baseline on non-overlapping 30d event study.
